name: roundtable-cli
description: Neutral peer debate orchestrator for local AI CLIs.

scripts.publish:alpha: pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm version prerelease --preid=alpha && pnpm publish --tag alpha && npm dist-tag add roundtable-cli@$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") latest
scripts.publish:production: pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm version patch && pnpm publish
